General.Name: EngineRootPath
General.Description: Path to the engine root directory, relative to the executable directory.

Animation.Name: SerialNum
Animation.Description: Classic character animation resource serial number.

Map.Name: FilePath
Map.Description: Classic MAP file relative to EngineRootPath (or absolute). Empty keeps animation preview.

Display.Name: ViewportScale
Display.Description: Scaling factor for the game viewport.

Display.Name: VSync
Display.Description: Use FIFO presentation; false requests immediate, then mailbox fallback.

Display.Name: Validation
Display.Description: Enable Vulkan validation; disable for performance measurements.

Benchmark.Name: ActorCount
Benchmark.Description: Optional fixed actor count, maximum 20000; zero derives count from visible cells.

Benchmark.Name: UniqueCharacters
Benchmark.Description: Distinct version/serial animation resources; no silent substitution.

Benchmark.Name: ActorsPerCell
Benchmark.Description: Zero disables density mode; otherwise fill each visible cell with 1..10 actors.

Benchmark.Name: ReportPath
Benchmark.Description: JSON report output path; required in benchmark mode.

Benchmark.Name: AnimationBudgetMiB
Benchmark.Description: Explicit benchmark animation RGBA payload budget, 16..1024 MiB; excludes GPU allocation overhead.

Benchmark.Name: BackgroundDecode
Benchmark.Description: Cold progressive diagnostic: one background CPU decode slot sharing the 32 MiB reservation; all Vulkan calls stay on the render thread.

Benchmark.Name: ProgressiveUploads
Benchmark.Description: Cold-load diagnostic: one pending clip, <=32 MiB decoded, <=4 MiB GPU copy per update; nonblocking fence polling.

Benchmark.Name: LoadDuringPlayback
Benchmark.Description: Diagnostic only: load one cold character per frame after warmup, with placeholders until ready. Synchronous, not production streaming.

Benchmark.Name: SwitchMotions
Benchmark.Description: Preload idle+walk, then switch the entire crowd every second without frame-loop uploads.

ServerDemo.Name: Enabled
ServerDemo.Description: Local server snapshot simulator: 128 visible actors and a 1.5x interest region.

Telemetry.Name: Enabled
Telemetry.Description: Enable bounded rolling CPU frame/resource diagnostics.

Telemetry.Name: ReportPath
Telemetry.Description: Optional JSON summary written on exit when telemetry is enabled.
